items.mainDefect: The guest email is not lowercased before it is checked against the lowercased blacklist, so a blacklisted address with different casing gets past the filter.

secondary.defect: The comparison against existing attendees is case-sensitive, so the same email in different casing can be added as a duplicate attendee.

items.mainDefect: The comparison against existing attendees is case-sensitive, so the same email in different casing is treated as new and added as a duplicate attendee.

secondary.defect: Uppercase guest emails are not matched against the lowercased blacklist, so blacklisted addresses can get through.
